rationale: The analysis identifies the supported causal chain and the required recovery mechanism, while correctly excluding database, CPU, and PDF-ticket explanations as primary causes. It is unusually well calibrated about residual uncertainties and recommends a direct, high-leverage repair. Minor causal/evidence overreach includes asserting that 65% CPU was below saturation, speculating about retries as the likely downstream mechanism, and treating normal database signals as fully excluding database involvement. Some relationship labeling also loosely treats scope and requirements as causal contributors.
